## InfraSightOps Enterprise v2.1.0

### Enterprise Security, Scoping & Automation
- **Multi-Client & Project Scope**: Organize servers by Client/Project in the credential vault with per-user project scope restrictions.
- **Environment-Aware Infrastructure Classification**: Classify servers across Production, UAT, QA, Development, and DR environments.
- **Environment-Aware Access Control**: Restrict execution permissions based on assigned environment scopes with automated audit trail logging.
- **Scoped Scheduled Automation**: Retain project and environment context on scheduled jobs with automatic creator authorization revalidation before execution.
- **Backend-Enforced Scope Isolation**: Strict API-level query enforcement ensuring users cannot bypass UI filters to access unauthorized project data.
- **Execution Safety & Guardrails**: Apply high-risk execution policies and extra validation controls to Production and DR operations.
- **Security Audit & Attribution**: Full audit logging for security-sensitive execution and authorization failure events.

### Core Platform Enhancements
- **Custom Application & Process Monitor**: Monitor custom services by adding patterns to /etc/health-check/custom_processes.txt with full executed command line arguments display.
- **Execution & Change Attribution**: Automated root-cause diagnostics identifying whether system mutations originated from Manual Admin Actions (Interactive SSH/TTY) or Automated System Tasks (Timers/Cron/Daemons).
- **Disk Under-Utilization Diagnostics**: Fixed JSON endpoint and export for Physical, LVM VG/LV, and Thin Pool discard advisories.
- **Multi-OS Compatibility Hardening**: Verified and hardened across RHEL 6-10, Amazon Linux 2/2023, Ubuntu 16.04-26.04, Debian 10-12, and SUSE SLES.
- **Interactive Pillar Recommendations**: Click-to-filter actionable recommendations by Pillar (Health, CIS Compliance, Diagnosis).
- **Settings UI & License Status**: Balanced 2-column layout with accurate Licensed Edition status display.
